note.zh: GAN 官方 Air 档案把该螺丝拼接设计追溯到 2011 年 GAN2；未找到首售日。
note.en: GAN's Air archive traces the screw-joined piece design to GAN2 in 2011; first sale date not located.

highlights.zh: 角棱块通过螺丝拼接的早期 GAN 设计。
highlights.en: An early GAN design using screws to join corner and edge parts.

summary.zh: 体现品牌成立前的研发脉络。
summary.en: Documents the development lineage before the later company launch.

tradeoffs.zh: 原始价目、尺寸和独立测试资料不足。
tradeoffs.en: Original pricing, dimensions and independent testing remain poorly documented.

note.zh: 官方技术史明确记载 2013 年 GAN3 上市；V2 的精确首售时间未核实。
note.en: GAN's technology history explicitly dates GAN3 to 2013; the V2 first sale date is unconfirmed.

note.zh: 检索时页面标价；停售档案也可能保留标价，不含运税且不代表中国售价。
note.en: Page-listed price at research time; discontinued archives may retain prices. Excludes shipping/taxes and is not a Chinese price.

adjustment.zh: 全塑一体轴心；通过螺母调节松紧。
adjustment.en: One-piece plastic core with nut-based tension adjustment.

highlights.zh: 一体成型柔性六臂 GansCore，是后续轴心发展的起点。
highlights.en: The flexible, one-piece six-arm GansCore established an early core architecture.

summary.zh: 历史价值在轴心和调节结构。
summary.en: Its historical importance lies in core construction and adjustment.

tradeoffs.zh: V2 棱块有细节修改；各版本不宜混用重量或发布日期。
tradeoffs.en: V2 changes edge details; weights and release dates should not be mixed between revisions.

note.zh: 旧店档案的 Release Date，由零售商标注，未独立核实为全球首发日。
note.en: The old store's retailer-labelled Release Date; not independently verified as the global launch.

note.zh: 历史页面或当年资料的显示报价；未将其冒充已确认首发价。
note.en: Price displayed in historical material; not asserted to be a confirmed launch price.

adjustment.zh: 5.5 mm 螺母工具调试柔性轴心。
adjustment.en: Flexible core adjusted with a 5.5 mm nut driver.

highlights.zh: 相对 GAN3 V2 加大尺寸，中心块更圆润。
highlights.en: Larger than GAN3 V2, with more rounded center pieces.

summary.zh: GAN 早期面向竞速的代表型号。
summary.en: A representative early GAN speedcube.

tradeoffs.zh: 零售档案记录核心在 2014 年夏季有更新，二手实物可能不同。
tradeoffs.en: Retail documentation notes a core revision in summer 2014, so surviving units can differ.

note.zh: 官方轴心史记 2015 年 GAN356；旧店给 356S 标注 2015-05-06，但该页后来覆盖了原 356。
note.en: GAN dates the 356 to 2015; the old store labels the 356S 2015-05-06, but this page was updated from the original 356.

note.zh: 历史页面或当年资料的显示报价；未将其冒充已确认首发价。
note.en: Price displayed in historical material; not asserted to be a confirmed launch price.

adjustment.zh: 钢塑一体 IPG 轴心，螺母松紧调节。
adjustment.en: Steel-plastic IPG core with nut tension adjustment.

highlights.zh: 从 357 的 57 mm 转为 56 mm。
highlights.en: Moves from the 357's 57 mm format to 56 mm.

highlights.zh: 356S 更新中心盖；保留为同一产品演进家族。
highlights.en: The 356S revises the center caps and is grouped with the original 356.

summary.zh: 56 mm 平台与钢塑轴心进入 GAN 主线。
summary.en: The 56 mm platform and steel-plastic core enter GAN's main line.

tradeoffs.en: The merged product archive cannot establish the original 356 launch day.

note.en: Advanced-edition price in the legacy store archive; the quotation date is unclear and it is not asserted as an official launch price.

adjustment.zh: 工具调节轴心松紧。
adjustment.en: Tool-based core tension adjustment.

highlights.zh: 更浅的角棱导槽，目标是提升稳定性和可控性。
highlights.en: Shallower corner and edge tracks aim to improve stability and control.

summary.en: An incremental revision of the 356 platform.

tradeoffs.en: Standard and Advanced mainly differ in sticker sets; they are not separate flagships.

coverageNotes: 本批收录 55 个 GAN 主牌家族、2 个 Monster Go 家族、2 个 Swift Block 家族和 1 个 Rubik's × GAN 合作家族；截止 2026-10-07。不是所有历史 SKU 均已穷尽。 / This batch covers 55 GAN families, two Monster Go, two Swift Block and one Rubik's × GAN collaboration through 2026-10-07; it is not a complete historical SKU inventory.

绝大多数报价是美国零售或品牌国际站页面价；只有找到官方证据的 GAN17 记录了人民币首发价 439 元。没有通过美元汇率换算伪造中国定价。 / Most prices are US or international listings. GAN17's CNY 439 launch price is supported by the official account; no exchange-rate conversion is presented as Chinese retail pricing.

重量和结构数据以具体版本为准，未把 Gross Weight 包装毛重填入净重。磁铁数、容错和自复位角度不是统一实测性能评分。 / Specifications are variant-specific; package gross weight is never used as cube weight. Magnet counts and claimed cutting/alignment angles are not standardized performance scores.
